description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Voidwielder.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Voidwielder and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Voidwielder from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Voidwielder enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Voidwielder.
Repeat from step 2.
